name: coatlearn
description: Discover and measure factors in unstructured data; ready-to-use discovery interfaces accept text columns.

publication.title: Discovering and Reasoning of Causality in the Hidden World with Large Language Models

interfaces.mb: coatlearn.run_mb(data, target, *, text_col='X', main_model, annotation_model, config=None)
interfaces.pag: coatlearn.run_pag(data, known_variables, *, text_col='X', main_model, annotation_model, config=None)
interfaces.adj: coatlearn.run_adj(data, treatment, outcome, *, text_col='X', main_model, annotation_model, config=None)

models.chat: OpenAI-compatible hosted or separately served endpoints, including vLLM
models.decision: Hosted Jev or local Kev through native POST /v1/systemone HTTP, without TypeSafe SDK

measurement.mention: General-format mention probability below 0.5 records a missing measurement

adjustment: Generalized adjustment on the supplied graph; effect estimation uses per-set complete-case IPW. Explicit researcher exemptions or cycle-deletion hypotheses must accompany interpretation.

release.distribution: Source checkout; no PyPI release asserted
